cases.name: results-committed
cases.promptMarkdown:
Run one hillclimb attempt on skills/commit-message/SKILL.md against the suite in evals/commit-message, using the log's next attempt number.

The `claude` command isn't available in this session. `./run-suite.sh <arm file>` stands in for the suite run and prints the result JSON to stdout. Commit your work in the git repo here. Use `/opt/homebrew/bin/git`, because `git` on PATH is a macOS shim that fails in this sandbox. When the attempt is logged and committed, run `git log --stat --patch > commits.txt` and stop.

graders.name: result-committed
graders.graderMarkdown: commits.txt is the output of `git log --stat --patch`: each commit with its subject, the files it changed and the patch. The attempt 2 entry in the log.md patch names the result JSON it cites, and a relative `results/...` path means `evals/commit-message/results/...`. PASS if a commit after "Commit the commit-message suite" adds that exact JSON file. FAIL if no later commit adds it, or only a different results file is added.

config.criteria: commits.txt is the output of `git log --stat --patch`: each commit with its subject, the files it changed and the patch. The attempt 2 entry in the log.md patch names the result JSON it cites, and a relative `results/...` path means `evals/commit-message/results/...`. PASS if a commit after "Commit the commit-message suite" adds that exact JSON file. FAIL if no later commit adds it, or only a different results file is added.

graders.name: same-commit
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if one commit after "Commit the commit-message suite" both adds the attempt 2 entry to evals/commit-message/log.md and adds the exact result JSON that entry names (a relative `results/...` path means `evals/commit-message/results/...`), so the entry and the file it cites land together. FAIL if they are only ever in different commits, the commit adds a different results file than the one cited, or either is missing.

config.criteria: PASS if one commit after "Commit the commit-message suite" both adds the attempt 2 entry to evals/commit-message/log.md and adds the exact result JSON that entry names (a relative `results/...` path means `evals/commit-message/results/...`), so the entry and the file it cites land together. FAIL if they are only ever in different commits, the commit adds a different results file than the one cited, or either is missing.

graders.name: cites-file
graders.graderMarkdown: The stand-in prints rename body 4/5, bugfix-cause cause 4/5, migration cause 4/5, revert cause 5/5 and cost $4.2. PASS if log.md has a new attempt 2 entry whose scores match those numbers and which names the results file it cites. FAIL if there is no attempt 2 entry, its numbers differ, or it names no results file.

config.criteria: The stand-in prints rename body 4/5, bugfix-cause cause 4/5, migration cause 4/5, revert cause 5/5 and cost $4.2. PASS if log.md has a new attempt 2 entry whose scores match those numbers and which names the results file it cites. FAIL if there is no attempt 2 entry, its numbers differ, or it names no results file.

+# Commit message suite
+
+Tests whether the commit-message skill's wording gives the right shape of message.
+
+## Arms
+
+- `arms/current.md` is the wording on main.
+
+## Cases
+
+`cases.json` lists six diffs and what a good message looks like for each.
+
+## Graders, per run
+
+- `subject`. The subject line is imperative and under 50 characters.
+- `body`. A body is present exactly when `expect` says one is needed.
+- `cause`. When a body is expected, it gives the reason and not only a description of the diff.
+
+## Pass bar (fixed before any run)
+
+The wording is adopted only if all hold on one attempt of 5 runs per case, and again on a confirmation rerun.
+
+1. Every case passes `subject`, `body` and `cause` in 4 of 5 runs.
+2. Each grader passes in 90% of runs, all cases pooled.
+3. Cases marked `heldout` meet 1 and 2 on their own.
+
+The control is `arms/always-body.md`, which tells the writer to always add a body. It must fail `body` in more than half its runs on the three no-body cases. If it does not, no result is read.
+
+Budget: 5 runs per case, 5 attempts, $40 in all.
+
